label: Lembert Studio Program · 2027
title: A Year of Creation
opening: One year. You go all in on what you want to create, and you let go of what's no longer needed. The parts of the business you have outgrown and kept anyway. The commitments you honor out of habit. The version of yourself that was useful five years ago but won't get you to create the next chapter of life.
You've bought into the idea that you have to pick. Results or peace. Money or presence. Scale or health. But what if that's simply what the world reports to us, not what YOU can create?
What if creating what you truly wanted wasn't at odds with anything you value, and you played the game with nothing held back?
questions: Have you ever dared to want what you want fully, and hold it as possible for longer than a day?

What happens in 10 months with a group of people who are all playing full out, who all treat failure as one more iteration on the way to creating what you want, and who will not let you quietly shrink your own ambition back to something you think is comfortable?
callToQuestion: Are you willing to create a year that looks impossible from where you stand right now?
qualifications: You run a business and have done so for more than 2 years. You are willing to take action that creates real movement in income, freedom, health, and aliveness.
You are not willing to compromise your health, peace, relationships, and fun.
Your business is established, or you have been steadily growing in the last year. You know there is a bigger game that attracts you, but you haven't dared to commit to it.

I repeat: you have to be willing to have success. This sounds obvious. It is not. Most people want it and then arrange their life so it stays just out of reach. Old structures and ideas hold you in place so you can keep the justifications alive and tell a story about why it's better not to go fully for it.
You bring the truth into a room of people doing the same.
notForLabel: This is not for you if
notFor: you are looking for a list of actions, a guru or permission
you want results without being willing to challenge what you believe
you are more interested in reasons than in action
you want to argue for the limitations of your life more than for its possibility
logistics: Ten months, from February to December 2027
A full day online at the start
A full day at the end to create 2028
promise: If you do not recoup your investment within the first 6 months, I gift you 6 coaching sessions and the rest of the year.
